### `GET /locations`

Every location, with today's hours, whether it is open at `at`, and its crowd level.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | query | string (date-time) or null | no |  |

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | list of [LocationSummary](#locationsummary) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `GET /locations/{location_id}`

One location: open status, hours for the next 7 days, and the menus listed from today on.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `location_id` | path | integer | yes |  |
| `at` | query | string (date-time) or null | no |  |

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | [LocationDetail](#locationdetail) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `GET /locations/{location_id}/menus`

Every menu at a location on `date` (default today), with all items at once.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `location_id` | path | integer | yes |  |
| `date` | query | string (date) or null | no |  |

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | list of [Menu](#menu) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `GET /freshness`

When ingestion last finished, and whether the data is stale at `at` (default now).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | query | string (date-time) or null | no |  |

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | [Freshness](#freshness) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `POST /filters/locations/{location_id}/menus`

Every menu at a location on `date` (default today), each item checked against every profile.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `location_id` | path | integer | yes |  |
| `date` | query | string (date) or null | no |  |

**Request body:** [FilterRequest](#filterrequest)

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | list of [FilteredMenu](#filteredmenu) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `POST /filters/group`

Every location, ranked for a group: where everyone has something that fits on `at`'s day.

Order: locations where everyone fits first, then those open at `at`, then by name.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | query | string (date-time) or null | no |  |

**Request body:** [FilterRequest](#filterrequest)

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | list of [GroupLocation](#grouplocation) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `POST /crowd/{location_id}`

Report how busy a location is right now. Returns the location's crowd level after it.

One report per location per client every CROWD_REPORT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS (429 otherwise).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `location_id` | path | integer | yes |  |

**Request body:** [CrowdReportIn](#crowdreportin)

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 201 Successful Response | [Crowd](#crowd) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `POST /auth/register`

Create an account and log in. 400 if the username or password isn't allowed,
409 if the username is taken. Usernames are case-insensitive.

**Request body:** [Credentials](#credentials)

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 201 Successful Response | [UserOut](#userout) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `POST /auth/login`

Log in. 401 for a wrong username or password (the message doesn't say which),
429 after too many failed tries for one username.

**Request body:** [Credentials](#credentials)

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | [UserOut](#userout) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `POST /auth/logout`

Log this browser out. Succeeds even if it wasn't logged in.

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 204 Successful Response |  |

### `GET /auth/me`

The logged-in account. 401 when logged out.

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | [UserOut](#userout) |

### `DELETE /auth/me`

Delete the logged-in account and everything tied to it. Needs the password.

**Request body:** [PasswordConfirm](#passwordconfirm)

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 204 Successful Response |  |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `PATCH /auth/me`

Change the logged-in account's settings: {"open_to_chat": true | false}.

**Request body:** [AccountSettings](#accountsettings)

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | [UserOut](#userout) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `GET /chat/rooms`

Return the rooms the current user has joined.

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | list of [ChatRoomOut](#chatroomout) |

### `POST /chat/rooms`

Create a pending room from the selected account IDs.

400 if the creator invites themselves, 404 if an invited account doesn't exist.

**Request body:** [ChatRoomCreate](#chatroomcreate)

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 201 Successful Response | [ChatRoomOut](#chatroomout) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `GET /chat/rooms/{room_id}`

Return the room's status and joined members.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `room_id` | path | integer | yes |  |

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | [ChatRoomOut](#chatroomout) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `POST /chat/rooms/{room_id}/leave`

Remove the current member and update the room status.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `room_id` | path | integer | yes |  |

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 204 Successful Response |  |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `GET /chat/invitations`

Return the current user's pending invitations.

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | list of [ChatInvitationOut](#chatinvitationout) |

### `POST /chat/invitations/{invitation_id}/accept`

Accept the current user's invitation and return the updated room.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `invitation_id` | path | integer | yes |  |

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | [ChatRoomOut](#chatroomout) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `POST /chat/invitations/{invitation_id}/decline`

Decline the current user's invitation.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `invitation_id` | path | integer | yes |  |

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 204 Successful Response |  |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `GET /chat/rooms/{room_id}/messages`

Return message history for a current member, even if the room is inactive.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `room_id` | path | integer | yes |  |

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | list of [ChatMessageOut](#chatmessageout) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `POST /chat/rooms/{room_id}/messages`

Save the text with the signed-in sender and return the saved message.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `room_id` | path | integer | yes |  |

**Request body:** [ChatMessageCreate](#chatmessagecreate)

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 201 Successful Response | [ChatMessageOut](#chatmessageout) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `GET /chat/users/{username}`

Find another account by exact username, ignoring case.

Returns the account ID and username even if Open to Chat is off.
400 for an invalid username or 404 when no other account matches.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | path | string | yes |  |

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | [OpenToChatPerson](#opentochatperson) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `GET /chat/open-to-chat`

Everyone else with Open to Chat on, by username.

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | list of [OpenToChatPerson](#opentochatperson) |

### `PUT /chat/open-to-chat`

Show or hide the current user on the Open to Chat list (off by default).

**Request body:** [OpenToChatUpdate](#opentochatupdate)

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | [OpenToChatOut](#opentochatout) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `GET /health`

Whether the API is up, can reach the database, and has the expected schema.

schema is "current", "outdated" (run the Alembic migrations), or null
when the database is unreachable.

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response |  |

## Data models

### AccountId

### AccountSettings

Settings the logged-in user can change. Extra fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `open_to_chat` | boolean | yes |

### ChatInvitationOut

A pending invitation the signed-in user can accept or decline.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes |
| `room_id` | integer | yes |

### ChatMessageCreate

The text a member sends to an active Chat Room.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes |

### ChatMessageOut

A saved message with its sender and the UTC time it was sent.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes |
| `text` | string | yes |
| `sender_id` | [AccountId](#accountid) or null | yes |
| `created_at` | string (date-time) | yes |

### ChatRoomCreate

The user IDs the creator sends when starting a Chat Room.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `invitee_ids` | list of [AccountId](#accountid) | yes |

### ChatRoomOut

A Chat Room and the users who have joined it.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes |
| `status` | [RoomStatus](#roomstatus) | yes |
| `member_ids` | list of [AccountId](#accountid) | yes |

### Credentials

A username and password, for signing up or logging in. Extra fields are rejected.

Lengths are checked loosely here and properly in services.auth, so the
error message can say what's wrong.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `username` | string | yes |
| `password` | string | yes |

### Crowd

A location's current crowd level, worked out from recent student reports.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `level` | `not_busy` / `moderate` / `crowded` or null | yes |
| `report_count` | integer | yes |
| `last_reported_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes |

### CrowdReportIn

A student's report of how busy a location is right now. Extra fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `level` | `not_busy` / `moderate` / `crowded` | yes |

### FilterRequest

The body of both filter endpoints: 1 to MAX_PROFILES profiles.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `profiles` | list of [Profile](#profile) | yes |

### FilteredItem

A menu item with one result per profile, in request order.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes |
| `name` | string | yes |
| `course` | string or null | yes |
| `serving_size` | string or null | yes |
| `allergens` | list of string | yes |
| `diets` | list of string | yes |
| `diets_removed` | object | no |
| `nutrition_unavailable` | boolean | no |
| `unrecognized_traits` | list of string | yes |
| `nutrition` | [Nutrition](#nutrition) or null | yes |
| `results` | list of [ItemResult](#itemresult) | yes |

### FilteredMenu

A menu whose items are each checked against every profile.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes |
| `date` | string (date) | yes |
| `meal` | string | yes |
| `scraped` | boolean | yes |
| `items` | list of [FilteredItem](#filtereditem) | yes |

### Freshness

When the scraped data was last updated, and whether it's stale.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `last_run_finished_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes |
| `last_run_status` | `ok` / `partial` or null | yes |
| `stale` | boolean | yes |
| `stale_after_hours` | integer | yes |

### GroupLocation

One location's answer for a group: is it open, and does everyone have something that fits.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes |
| `name` | string | yes |
| `is_open` | boolean or null | yes |
| `closes_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes |
| `opens_next_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes |
| `items_checked` | integer | yes |
| `everyone_fits` | boolean | yes |
| `profiles` | list of [ProfileCounts](#profilecounts) | yes |

### HTTPValidationError

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `detail` | list of [ValidationError](#validationerror) | no |

### HoursDay

A location's hours on one date, as published on dining.ncsu.edu.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `date` | string (date) | yes |
| `status` | `open` / `closed` / `unknown` | yes |
| `periods` | list of [Period](#period) | yes |
| `raw_text` | string or null | yes |

### ItemResult

One item's verdict for one profile, and why it isn't "fits".

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `verdict` | `fits` / `conflicts` / `incomplete` | yes |
| `reasons` | list of string | yes |

### LocationDetail

A location's summary plus 7 days of hours (from today) and its menus from today on.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes |
| `name` | string | yes |
| `description` | string or null | yes |
| `dining_url` | string or null | yes |
| `is_open` | boolean or null | yes |
| `closes_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes |
| `opens_next_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes |
| `today` | [HoursDay](#hoursday) | yes |
| `crowd` | [Crowd](#crowd) | yes |
| `hours` | list of [HoursDay](#hoursday) | yes |
| `menus` | list of [MenuSummary](#menusummary) | yes |

### LocationSummary

A location with today's hours, whether it's open, and its crowd level.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes |
| `name` | string | yes |
| `description` | string or null | yes |
| `dining_url` | string or null | yes |
| `is_open` | boolean or null | yes |
| `closes_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes |
| `opens_next_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes |
| `today` | [HoursDay](#hoursday) | yes |
| `crowd` | [Crowd](#crowd) | yes |

### Menu

One meal's menu on one day, with its items.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes |
| `date` | string (date) | yes |
| `meal` | string | yes |
| `scraped` | boolean | yes |
| `items` | list of [MenuItem](#menuitem) | yes |

### MenuItem

One dish on a menu, with its allergens, diets, and nutrition label if it has one.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes |
| `name` | string | yes |
| `course` | string or null | yes |
| `serving_size` | string or null | yes |
| `allergens` | list of string | yes |
| `diets` | list of string | yes |
| `diets_removed` | object | no |
| `nutrition_unavailable` | boolean | no |
| `unrecognized_traits` | list of string | yes |
| `nutrition` | [Nutrition](#nutrition) or null | yes |

### MenuSummary

One meal's menu on one day, without its items.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes |
| `date` | string (date) | yes |
| `meal` | string | yes |
| `scraped` | boolean | yes |

### Nutrition

An item's nutrition label from NetNutrition. Values it doesn't give are null, not zero.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `serving_size` | string or null | yes |
| `calories` | number or null | yes |
| `protein_g` | number or null | yes |
| `fat_g` | number or null | yes |
| `carbs_g` | number or null | yes |
| `sodium_mg` | number or null | yes |
| `ingredients` | string or null | yes |
| `contains` | list of string | yes |
| `missing_fields` | list of string | yes |
| `ingredient_flags` | object | yes |
| `fetched_at` | string (date-time) | yes |

### OpenToChatOut

The signed-in user's Open to Chat setting after a change.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `open_to_chat` | boolean | yes |

### OpenToChatPerson

The ID and username of an account that can be invited to a Chat Room.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | [AccountId](#accountid) | yes |
| `username` | string | yes |

### OpenToChatUpdate

The setting a signed-in user sends to turn Open to Chat on or off.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `open_to_chat` | boolean | yes |

### PasswordConfirm

The current password, to confirm deleting the account.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `password` | string | yes |

### Period

One opening period, from opens_at to closes_at (campus time).

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `opens_at` | string (date-time) | yes |
| `closes_at` | string (date-time) | yes |

### Profile

One person's dietary needs in a filter request.

Unknown fields, allergens, or diets are rejected (422), never ignored.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string or null | no |
| `avoid` | list of `dairy` / `egg` / `gluten` / `nuts` / `pork` / `seafood` / `sesame` / `soy` | no |
| `diets` | list of `halal` / `vegan` / `vegetarian` | no |
| `min_protein_g` | number or null | no |
| `max_calories` | number or null | no |
| `max_sodium_mg` | number or null | no |

### ProfileCounts

For one profile at one location: how many items fit, are incomplete, or conflict.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string or null | yes |
| `fits` | integer | yes |
| `incomplete` | integer | yes |
| `conflicts` | integer | yes |

### UserOut

The signed-in account. Never includes the password hash.

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes |
| `username` | string | yes |
| `open_to_chat` | boolean | yes |
| `created_at` | string (date-time) | yes |

### ValidationError

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `loc` | list of string or integer | yes |
| `msg` | string | yes |
| `type` | string | yes |
| `input` | any | no |
